# Astronomical 0.2.43
## Fixed
- **Honest cache-reuse reporting**: `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` now reports every restored prompt token — dense and SpecPrefill sparse alike. A session reusing ~97% of its prompt previously reported ~0% to usage consumers. - **Dense prompt-cache capture after SpecPrefill restore**: conversation tails processed after a sparse restore are now published to the SSD cache and restored by later requests. Previously the restored prefix stayed frozen while every request re-prefilled the entire growing tail; time-to-first-token climbed with each message. Now each request pays only its new tokens and stays in the low single-digit seconds.
## Preserved
- Existing SSD prompt-cache state remains valid; new anchored chains build on top of previously captured prefixes. - Image (visual) requests keep their previous prompt-cache behavior. - No configuration or model-artifact changes are required.
## Distribution
- macOS arm64 DMG, Developer ID–signed with Hardened Runtime, notarized and stapled. - Sparkle update feed Ed25519-signed; in-app updates verify signatures before installing.
